title: Superheroes
tagline: From Superman to Birdman without noticing the water got hot.

levels.name: Popcorn
levels.note: Flying men, jet packs, a super family, the Spider-Verse, a raccoon and seven evil exes.

levels.name: Blockbusters
levels.note: Stark, Raimi's Spider-Man, X2, Cap, the Avengers, and RRR's two Indian revolutionaries.

levels.name: Batman
levels.note: Burton, the animated one, Nolan and Reeves.

levels.name: Cult and dark
levels.note: Vampires, revenge, demons, Hong Kong heroines, kids who kill and Mega-City One.

levels.name: Deconstructions
levels.note: Old Wolverine and a slow, quiet origin story.

levels.name: Final boss
levels.note: The Joker and a superhero actor's breakdown.

levels.name: Cooked
levels.note: Only if they finish Birdman and ask for more.

core.b: Christopher Reeve makes you believe a man can fly. Earnest, funny and still the template.

seq.note: Zod, 'Kneel before Zod!', and the best Superman fight

br.note: Adam West's camp classic: shark repellent bat-spray
James Gunn's bright, hopeful reboot with David Corenswet and Krypto
Gal Gadot in No Man's Land: the best of the recent DC films
A kid who turns into a grown-up superhero: Big with lightning

core.b: A 1938 stunt pilot finds a jet pack, and the Nazis want it. Old-fashioned adventure in the Raiders mould.

br.note: Mario Bava's Italian comic supervillain: pop-art heists, gorgeous to look at
Primary colours, prosthetics and Al Pacino going large
Jim Carrey as a living cartoon

core.b: Pixar's retired superhero family, forced back into action. Also the best Fantastic Four film.

br.note: A supervillain with no hero to fight
A boy and his inflatable robot. On Sci-fi

core.b: Miles Morales and a multiverse of Spider-People, animated like a comic come alive. Possibly the best superhero film ever made.

seq.note: Even more dazzling. Ends on a cliffhanger

core.b: Space misfits, a talking raccoon and a tree, and a 70s mixtape. Marvel's funniest.

br.note: Taika Waititi turns Thor into a comedy

core.b: Edgar Wright: Michael Cera must defeat his girlfriend's seven evil exes, with video-game powers, combos and coins. Also on Action.
Robert Downey Jr. builds a suit in a cave and becomes Tony Stark forever. Where the Marvel films began.

br.note: Wakanda, and Michael B. Jordan's Killmonger, the best Marvel villain
Marvel's misfits and a film about depression. A late surprise

core.b: Raimi: Peter Parker can't pay his rent, and Doc Ock. The train fight.

br.note: Tom Holland's high-school Spidey and Michael Keaton's Vulture
Three Spider-Men, a nostalgia overload

core.b: The X-Men and Magneto team up against a mutant-hunting colonel. Nightcrawler in the White House.

br.note: Young Xavier and Magneto in the 60s
Old and young X-Men across time

core.b: Cap in a 70s paranoia thriller: S.H.I.E.L.D. is rotten and his best friend is the assassin.

br.note: A WW2 adventure serial from The Rocketeer's director
The airport fight

core.b: Joss Whedon assembles the team: bickering heroes, Loki, and the Battle of New York. The fair-to-Marvel pick.

br.note: Thanos, and the snap
The payoff for 22 films. Needs the homework

core.b: Two revolutionaries in 1920s India, one a cop, one a rebel, best friends who don't know it. A tiger fight, a dance-off, a bridge rescue. Three hours of pure joy.

br.note: Statham must keep his adrenaline up or die. Also on Action
A car flies between Abu Dhabi skyscrapers
The Rock and Statham, physics optional

core.w: Three hours, subtitled, very violent in places.

core.b: Tim Burton: Michael Keaton's Batman, Nicholson's Joker, Prince on the soundtrack and Gotham as gothic noir.

br.note: Jim Carrey's Riddler. Neon nonsense

core.b: Burton's Christmas fairy tale: Michelle Pfeiffer's Catwoman, Danny DeVito's grotesque Penguin.
The animated series' film: a vigilante killing gangsters, and Bruce's lost love. Arguably the best Batman story on film.
Nolan: Bruce Wayne learns fear, the League of Shadows and the Tumbler. Better than The Dark Knight, some say.
Heath Ledger's Joker turns Gotham into a moral experiment. The superhero film as crime epic.

seq.note: Bane, and the end of Nolan's trilogy

core.b: Matt Reeves: Robert Pattinson's Batman as a detective, the Riddler as a serial killer. Rain, Nirvana, three hours.
Wesley Snipes' half-vampire hunter and the blood-rave opening.

br.note: Tom Hardy argues with his alien goo

core.b: Brandon Lee's murdered musician returns for revenge. Lee was killed during filming.
Del Toro: Ron Perlman's demon detective, Nazis and Lovecraftian tentacles.

br.note: Keanu Reeves as a chain-smoking exorcist

core.b: Michelle Yeoh, Anita Mui and Maggie Cheung as three Hong Kong superheroines against a eunuch who steals babies. Johnnie To directs, Ching Siu-tung flies everyone on wires. Gloriously daft. Also on Asian action.

seq.note: The same year's darker, post-apocalyptic sequel

br.note: Jet Li as an escaped super-soldier in a Kato mask. Also on Asian action
Stephen Chow's tenement landlords with cartoon kung fu powers. On Asian action
Shaolin monks with superhuman football skills. Core on Asian action
Jackie Chan's comic adaptation, with the Street Fighter parody scene
A Hong Kong comic adaptation: wire-fu, early CGI and floppy hair
Cantopop duo Twins fight vampires; Jackie Chan cameo, Donnie Yen fights

core.b: A teenager with no powers puts on a costume and nearly dies. Then Hit-Girl arrives.

br.note: Mark Millar's spy spoof. Also on Action
James Gunn: Rainn Wilson's wrench-wielding vigilante. Funny, then horrifying
An office drone learns to curve bullets with Angelina Jolie
Ryan Reynolds' fourth-wall-breaking smartmouth
James Gunn's gory, funny do-over of DC's villain team

core.w: Very violent, including a child doing the killing.

core.b: A masked anarchist and Natalie Portman take on a fascist Britain. Remember, remember.
Sam Raimi's pre-Spider-Man pulp anti-hero: Liam Neeson, burned and furious.
Karl Urban's judge, a tower block and the drug Slo-Mo. Also on Action.

br.note: Frank Miller's black-and-white-and-red noir. On Crime & Noir
Stallone takes his helmet off
Frank Miller's Spartans: abs, slow-motion and 'This is Sparta!'

core.b: An old, dying Wolverine drives a mute girl to the border. Shane with claws.
M. Night Shyamalan: Bruce Willis survives a train crash untouched, and Samuel L. Jackson knows why. A slow, quiet origin story.

br.note: Three teenagers get telekinesis, filmed on their own cameras
Zack Snyder's shot-for-shot comic adaptation. Divisive
James McAvoy's 23 personalities, secretly an Unbreakable sequel

core.b: Joaquin Phoenix's failed comedian becomes the Joker in a Taxi Driver-style Gotham.
Michael Keaton, once a superhero star, stages a Broadway play to be taken seriously. Filmed as one long take.
core.q: Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)
